# ESP32-TUX tested release area

No Panlee-tested ESP32-TUX release artifact exists yet.

A firmware artifact may be listed here only after:

1. the exact source/adaptation revision is recorded;
2. the build configuration and partition layout are recorded;
3. the firmware is physically flashed to the named Panlee specimen;
4. boot, display and touch are verified;
5. any additional claimed functions are individually tested;
6. the artifact hashes and flash offsets are recorded.

Do not publish an upstream prebuilt image as a Panlee-validated release merely because the board name matches.
